{{Wireless adapter |brand=AzureWave |model=AW-NB048H |revision= |upc= |ean= |asin= |price= |est_release_date= |fcc_date=10/09/2009 |manuf_country= |manuf= |manuf_model= |manuf_rev= |if=Mini PCIe (half) |vendor_id=168c |device_id=002b |subvendor_id= |subdevice_id= |fcc_id=PPD-AR5B195 |ic_id=4104A-AR5B195 |chip1_brand=Atheros |chip1_model=AR9285L |chip2_brand= |chip2_model= |chip3_brand= |chip3_model= |flags=bluetooth |ant_conn=U.FL |802dot11_protocols=bgn |txchains=1 |rxchains=1 |sstreams=1 |oui=00:08:CA,1C:4B:D6 |lin_driver= |win_driver= }} This device uses the [[Atheros AR5B195]] / WB195 reference design, but uses the L variant of the AR9285.
